workingHours.title: Working hours
workingHours.description: The breach clock only runs during these hours, IST. It stops overnight, at weekends, and on company holidays — so "2 business days" means two of these shifts, not 48 hours. Holidays come from the Leave module.

deskIdentity.title: Desk identity & targets
deskIdentity.description: Ticket id prefix, the timezone day boundaries resolve in, and the breach thresholds. These were fixed in code; the values shown are the defaults still in force if you never change them.
deskIdentity.prefixInvalid: 1–10 letters or digits, starting with a letter.
deskIdentity.thresholdsInvalid: Amber must be a smaller number of days than red, and both above zero.
deskIdentity.prefixWarning: Saving relabels every existing ticket as {prefix}-<number>. Replies quoting the old prefix will still thread correctly.
